wholePhysicalScope: The named historic fort outline contains 96 points, marking long hillside curtain runs, salient corners and rounded tower projections. The historic summit fort is spatially separate from the lower gateways and city wall circuit.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the continuous hilltop ramparts and rounded bastions. Near levels show the ashlar coping, low parapets and individual masonry details.
limitations: Coping widths, thicknesses, tower crown heights, and mortar details are estimated from the mapped wall shape and the historic silhouette. The open outline of the hilltop remains visible.
The recipe depicts the documented exterior masonry. The city wall below and separately mapped historic temples and gateways are outside the model.
